data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to interact with the Meta SDK for analytics and ads tracking.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple interface to initialize the Meta SDK, set user data for advanced attribution, and log standard events, purchases, and custom events across Android, iOS, and Web.
use_when: You need to integrate Meta App Events in a Flutter mobile app.
You need to integrate Meta Pixel tracking in a Flutter web app.
avoid_when: You are not using Meta advertising or analytics products in your app.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Supports iOS CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager.
Automates iOS UIScene lifecycle and URL forwarding.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration in native Info.plist and AndroidManifest files.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring App IDs, Client Tokens, and permissions in iOS Info.plist and Android AndroidManifest.xml.
